**DI62** is a medical diagnosis code representing "other nontraumatic intracranial hemorrhage" (andre ikke-traumatiske intrakranielle blødninger) [^src1]. Within the Danish healthcare system's quality monitoring frameworks, specifically the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), DI62 plays a critical role in tracking patient safety and treatment complications [^src1]. 

Specifically, DI62 is utilized as part of a defined set of ICD-10 codes to measure the incidence of [[intrakraniel-bloedning|Intrakraniel blødning]] among patients with [[atrieflimren]] [^src1]. When calculating the incidence of intracranial bleeding, DI62 is grouped alongside codes such as [[di60|DI60]], [[di61|DI61]], [[ds064|DS064]], [[ds065|DS065]], and [[ds066|DS066]] [^src1]. Furthermore, this code is incorporated into a broader composite indicator for severe bleeding (alvorlig blødning), which aggregates intracranial hemorrhage codes with gastrointestinal and urinary/respiratory bleeding codes to comprehensively monitor the safety of anticoagulation therapies [^src1]. 

The consistent use of DI62 across multiple annual AFDK reports from 2023 through 2025 underscores its importance as a standardized metric for evaluating the risks associated with antithrombotic treatments in prevalent atrial fibrillation populations [^src2], [^src3], [^src4], [^src5]. By capturing these specific non-traumatic bleeding events, healthcare authorities can assess the real-world safety profiles of clinical interventions and adjust treatment guidelines accordingly.
